candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return address(0) when _owner is zero, otherwise return _owner (introduces different returned value when owner is zero).
Change owner() to always return tx.origin instead of _owner.
Change owner() to always return msg.sender instead of _owner.
Remove the check that newOwner is not the zero address, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)).
Also emit OwnershipTransferred only when newOwner differs from current owner by adding a conditional around _transferOwnership and emit (effectively preventing change when same owner).
Weaken onlyOwner to use tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing transferOwnership to be callable by contracts that initiated transaction.
Change paused() to always return true instead of reading the _paused state variable.
Change setKeeper to assign keeper only when new address is non-zero; otherwise leave owner unchanged (so call may not change keeper).
Make setKeeper set keeper to the caller rather than the provided address (so keeper after call differs when caller != _keeper).
Make setKeeper emit event but not update state (so keeper remains unchanged after call).
Remove owner check in onlyOwner modifier so setKeeper can be called by anyone, potentially changing keeper to caller-provided value instead of owner-controlled value.
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment to half the provided value.
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment to a constant (0), ignoring input.
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment to max BPS (10000) regardless of input.
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment to input plus 1.
Modify onlyOwner check to compare owner() against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, allowing different callers to pass and potentially change state.
